tasks.build: deno task build:docs && deno task build:home
tasks.check: deno check --frozen home/main.ts docs/main.ts home/vite.config.ts docs/vite.config.ts tests/smoke_test.ts && deno lint home/app.tsx home/main.ts home/client.ts home/server.js home/vite.config.ts docs/app.tsx docs/main.ts docs/client.ts docs/server.js docs/vite.config.ts shared/types.ts tests/ && deno fmt --check deno.json home/deno.json docs/deno.json shared/deno.json home/app.tsx home/main.ts home/client.ts home/server.js home/vite.config.ts docs/app.tsx docs/main.ts docs/client.ts docs/server.js docs/vite.config.ts shared/types.ts tests/ wrangler.jsonc wrangler.docs.jsonc
tasks.preview:docs: deno task wrangler dev --config docs/_fresh/server/wrangler.json --port 5173 --inspector-port 0 --persist-to docs/.wrangler/state --local
tasks.preview:home: deno task wrangler dev --config home/_fresh/server/wrangler.json --port 5174 --inspector-port 0 --persist-to home/.wrangler/state --local
tasks.dry-run:docs: deno task wrangler deploy --dry-run --config docs/_fresh/server/wrangler.json --outdir docs/.wrangler/dry-run
tasks.dry-run:home: deno task wrangler deploy --dry-run --config home/_fresh/server/wrangler.json --outdir home/.wrangler/dry-run
